title.narrative: National Conference and Workshop on Teachers and Emerging Technologies in Education

description.narrative: The National Conference and Workshop, entitled: Emerging Education Technologies for Iranian Teachers is an opportunity to provide a premier interdisciplinary platform for policymakers, researchers, practitioners and educators to present and discuss the most recent innovations, trends, and concerns as well as practical challenges encountered in the global as well as the country level and the best solutions adopted in the field of ICT in Education and Training, with a focus on teachers training and education and it is an opportunity for capacity building on the issue in the country. Through the workshop, the participants will be acquainted with the major educational technologies and the best ICT practices currently available for teachers across the world and the ways which make teachers capable of taking a more effective role in ensuring equitable use of technology and creating world-class educational digital content and capacity. It is supposed this event would provide an opportunity to recover the current situation of ICT’s application in Education in Iran and develop the academic networks for collaboration and partnership to promote new technologies in school and teacher education and training, in the country.
